Valeria (CSM): Quick sync for Valeria Co private/VPC onboarding. Remaining blockers: firewall NAT IPs, IAM role trust naming, KMS alias + key policy, CloudTrail retention policy, Splunk cert. Need short updates so we can lock cutover.

Ben (Net Eng): They sent subnets 10.55.0.0/16 and said egress uses provider NAT but haven't given static egress IPs. We need the NAT pool to pin firewall rules. Recommend minimal ingress: 443 -> redwood-proxy, 2200 -> bastion from their corp CIDR only.

Renee (SRE): KMS: they created CMK with alias `alias/valeria-main` and key-id `f1e2d3c4-0000`. Our deploy automation expects `alias/redwood-customer-valeria`. Temporary workaround: reference key-id in stack, but rotation automation won't detect the key without the alias. I'll add fallback steps in runbook.

Sanjay (Security): CloudTrail retention: they currently retain 60d. Our enterprise baseline for priv deployments is 365d; this is a renewal risk. Valeria Co asked about cost. Valeria (CSM): please share delta and archival options (Glacier/IA).

Valeria (CSM): Will send cost delta & propose lifecycle to Glacier after 30 days as a lower-cost compromise. Also asked them to add our runner role ARN to the CMK key policy; they replied "can do tonight".

Ben (Net Eng): Firewall snippet I posted in ticket CS-21901:
```
- allow tcp 443 from 10.55.0.0/16 to 10.12.4.10/32 (redwood-proxy)
- allow tcp 2200 from 198.51.100.0/24 to 10.12.4.20/32 (bastion)
- allow tcp 8443 from 10.55.10.0/24 to 10.12.4.11/32 (collector)
```
If they route via transit GW, ask for ASN + route table.

Renee (SRE): Quick runbook note: `if alias != alias/redwood-customer-*, use key-id and create follow-up CS task to rename alias before rotation`. Adding snippet for CLI alias creation:
```
aws kms create-alias --alias-name alias/redwood-customer-valeria --target-key-id f1e2d3c4-0000
```

Sanjay (Security): Also confirm whether S3 bucket for logs uses SSE-KMS. If so, CMK policy must permit `s3:PutObject` from `arn:aws:iam::111122223333:role/redwood-runner`. Valeria (CSM) pls confirm with their infra.

Valeria (CSM): I'll confirm SSE-KMS and push the alias + key policy change. Also need collector fqdn + owner email to issue Splunk cert. cert-bot, please standby.

cert-bot: Ready. Provide fqdn and contact email. Will issue PEM cert signed by redwood-internal, TTL 90d.

Valeria (CSM): Action items recap:
- Valeria: send retention cost delta + Glacier option (due EOD)
- Ben: apply firewall once NAT IPs provided
- Renee: deploy with key-id fallback and add runbook steps for alias rename
- Sanjay: validate CMK policy after they update
- cert-bot: issue cert once fqdn/email received
I'll update ticket CS-21901 and run mid-week check-in. :thumbsup:
